ache.title: An “F2P deck” is still a deck to open packs for
ache.note: Nero builds a grass deck around Celebi EX, Serperior and his Caterpie line from the Mythical Island expansion. Calling it F2P is kind, but a new expansion still nudges you to open packs to collect the pieces. Free decks are a nice idea. Just don’t let them turn into a reason to chase cards.
watch: a new expansion pulling you back in
ache.tip: Build with the cards you already have. If a deck needs luck to finish, it isn’t really free.
lines: F2P means free. hold them to it
new expansion, same pack slot machine
